session_turns.message:
I haven't fixed it, and I stopped before changing anything. The cause is in `config/default.json`, which has `uploads.maxMb` set to `5`. That's why an 8 MB file is rejected and the uploads test fails. The fix is to change it to `10`, which matches `docs/product.md`.

A Fenceline rule on this project blocks edits to `config/`. The rule says "config/: shared with ops, off-limits". My edit was rejected, and I haven't tried to get around it.

`src/api/body-limit.js` computes its limit from `maxMb`, so it will move to 11 MB with this change. The "12 MB is rejected" test should also pass once the limit is 10.

The suite currently has 2 tests passing and 2 failing, and I haven't re-run it since, because I made no change.

You could change `maxMb` to `10` yourself, or ask ops to. Or if you tell me I'm allowed to edit `config/`, I'll make the change and run `npm test`.
